pictures.author: A.Savin

pictures.inspected: Inspected complete southeast oblique: central raised white two-storey house with triangular pediment and round-headed attic glazing; lower connecting ranges, wider end pavilions, green metal roofs, four front arched dormers, end basement doors with pediment hoods and low basement windows. Two pale chimney stacks visible; hedges obscure the central lower entrance.

pictures.inspected: Inspected reverse southeast/south oblique: full connected envelope, raised central pediment, stepped green roofs and arched dormers; pale end cellar door under small pediment hood and basement glazing; far end and lower central entrance partly obscured. Rear faces remain an explicitly approximate exterior reconstruction.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete connected Volkonsky House and both mapped wings at Yasnaya Polyana: raised central two-storey block with gabled pediment and semicircular attic glazing; lower long connecting ranges and wider end pavilions follow all three actual mapped parts. Green standing-seam pitched/hipped roofs, small arched dormers, two pale chimney proxies, repeated white window frames, shallow pilasters/cornices, two recessed end cellar doors with small pediment hoods, central recessed entrance and side recessed doorway with supported treads. Basement bands preserve the original slope. Hidden rear bays/doors and exact historical levels remain approximate. No copied plaques, inscriptions, furnishings, artworks or photo pixels.
